lines.text: Judges and officials are appointed in every town, and justice alone is pursued so the people may possess the land.
No Asherah pole may be set up by the altar, and no flawed ox or sheep may be sacrificed.
A proven worshiper of other gods is stoned at the gates on the word of twelve witnesses.
A case too hard to judge goes to the Levitical priests and the judge at the place the LORD chooses.
The king must not acquire many horses or wives, and must write his own scroll before the elders.

wrong_details.true: in the presence of the Levitical priests
